name: _related.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  internals/_related.scss — the related-projects mosaic strip at the
//  bottom of the project page: packed tile layout, the border-sheen
//  hover keyframes, and reduced-motion + :host-context fallbacks.
//  Imported by internals.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Mosaic Layout for Related Projects (Zero Empty Gaps) ──────────────────────
$_B_RELATED: 'related-mosaic';

// Related-projects strip at the bottom of the project page.
.#{$_B_RELATED} {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3xl);

  @include layout-768() {
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }

  &-item {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--space-lg);
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-height: to-rem(160);
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-lg) rgba($color-black, 0.15);
    transition:
      transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      box-shadow 0.35s ease;

    // Mobile: always full-width (base styles: flex: 1 1 100%; width: 100%; max-width: 100%)

    // Tablet: enforce exactly 2 columns — 50% minus half the row gap
    @include layout-768() {
      flex: 0 0 calc(50% - var(--space-lg) / 2);
      max-width: calc(50% - var(--space-lg) / 2);
      min-height: to-rem(190);
    }

    // Desktop: standard mosaic width
    @include layout-1024() {
      flex: 1 1 to-rem(260);
      max-width: to-rem(360);
      min-height: to-rem(200);
    }

    &.router-link-active {
      display: none;
    }

    // Living tile edge — same hairline sheen as the home mosaic: a
    // gradient ring clipped to border-width via mask-composite, drifting
    // on a slow alternate loop.
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      padding: var(--space-hairline);
      background: linear-gradient(
        120deg,
        transparent 32%,
        var(--border-item-hover) 45%,
        var(--color-accent-contrast) 50%,
        var(--border-item-hover) 55%,
        transparent 68%
      );
      background-size: 300% 300%;
      -webkit-mask:
        linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0) content-box,
        linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0);
      -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
      mask:
        linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0) content-box,
        linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0);
      mask-composite: exclude;
      animation: related-border-sheen 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    // Featured items are wider ONLY on desktop (1024px+); ignored on mobile and tablet
    &--featured {
      @include layout-1024() {
        flex: 2 1 to-rem(560);
        max-width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      }
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      transform: translateY(#{to-rem(-$space-xs)}) scale(1.01);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);

      .#{$_B_RELATED}-img {
        transform: scale(1.06);
      }

      .#{$_B_RELATED}-title {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
    }
  }

  &-media {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  &-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  &-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(
      to top,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88) 0%,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 50%,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 100%
    );
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &-info {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg) var(--space-lg);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
    text-align: left;
    pointer-events: none;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl);
    }

    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item--featured & {
      padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-2xl);
      }
    }
  }

  &-title {
    @extend %TTL_BASE;
    @extend %TTL_SM;

    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 200;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(0.8);
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    text-shadow: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md) rgba($color-black, 0.6);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;

    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item--featured & {
      font-size: var(--space-lg);

      @include layout-768() {
        font-size: var(--space-xl);
      }
      @include layout-1024() {
        font-size: var(--space-2xl);
      }
    }
  }

  &-desc {
    @extend %TXT_BASE;
    @extend %TXT_XS;

    font-weight: 200;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    text-shadow: 0 var(--space-hairline) var(--space-sm) var(--bg-dark);
    max-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      max-height 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      margin-top 0.25s ease,
      opacity 0.25s ease;

    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item:hover &,
    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item:focus-within & {
      max-height: var(--space-5xl);
      margin-top: var(--space-2xs);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

@keyframes related-border-sheen {
  0% {
    background-position: 0% 0%;
  }

  100% {
    background-position: 100% 100%;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .#{$_B_RELATED}-item::after {
    animation: none;
  }
}

// Shadow DOM: mirror the store-driven html.reduced-motion flag.
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .#{$_B_RELATED}-item::after {
  animation: none;
}
